name: TravelKitSR
subtitle: Travel Gear E-Commerce & Product Sales
challenge: Convert fast-scrolling mobile users on Instagram into direct e-commerce purchasers for modular travel gear and luggage organizers without discounting margins.
approach: Engineered dynamic demonstration reels showing practical luggage packing space savings and modular waterproof pockets.
Targeted international travelers, frequent flyers, and upcoming holiday planners with high-engagement video placements.
Optimized mobile landing pages for single-click Apple Pay / UPI checkout to minimize purchase abandonment.
result: Scaled direct product purchases across Instagram Reels placements with high engagement rates and profitable return on ad spend.
